excludedProbes.reason: The added Home probe expected capitalised Prices despite correct lowercase qualified text. The added Historic probe guessed a Crown Tavern detail URL absent from the public catalogue. Corrected probes check the savings date qualification and actual Southwark Historic filter. Both passed without a product change.
The added exact Name locator omitted the helpful text included in the accessible name. The corrected accessible-name prefix drove both full five-step previews successfully.

The first asset probe guessed leadenhall-market from its public caption. The actual public asset identifier is leadenhall-boxhall. Corrected HTTP probes passed for all four displayed places, both formats and both sizes.

freshEvidence: All runtime receipts and screenshots here were created in this run. Existing tracked before views remain historical. The initial browser run also passed. The final browser run retained a separate output directory after the Pal run reused the first output directory.
